text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after a meeting.
Hishi Miracle was enthusiastically reading an info magazine.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufun♪ I've been doing nothing but training lately, so I haven't checked out the autumn fashion at all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this Mont Blanc...
With chestnut butter cream inside, it's gotta be delicious~! I wanna eat it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle had been working quite hard
at training lately. Maybe it would be fine
to give her a reward.
choice_data_list: Want to go out to eat on our next day off? My treat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really? Are you sure?
Yaaay, Mont Blanc~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so came the weekend.
I arrived at the cafe famous for its Mont Blanc, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...A one-hour wait. Aw, man...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, I guess it makes sense since it's featured in magazines.
Alright, time to retreat.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No way, a one-hour wait is way too rough~.
I'll come back on a weekday when it's not so crowded.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but I might actually be a little hungry.
...Trainer-san, wanna go grab that?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, so yummy!
It's so warm~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What she said she wanted to eat was a steamed meat bun.
Huffing and blowing on it, she happily stuffs her cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Getting both a meat bun and a bean paste bun.
What a lavish treat~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: When meat buns start showing up in convenience stores, you really feel like autumn is here~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, right now, we are thoroughly
enjoying autumn to the absolute fullest, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, just eating a meat bun and heading home
feels a bit dull. There are plenty of other ways to enjoy autumn.
choice_data_list: Since we're here, let's swing by the famous autumn foliage spot too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Autumn leaves? Hmm...
I guess that's fine either way...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Since it's the weekend, the trains are packed... and walking around once we get there... It's just so exhausting, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, autumn leaves at Tracen Academy... ah.
Autumn leaf viewing right here at the academy! Let's do that, okay~?"
choice_data_list: ...Well, if you are fine with that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"What a magnificent view, truly a magnificent view!"
Ehehe, that was my impression of No Reason-chan~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Before I knew it,
they'd changed colors so beautifully.
I'm glad they haven't scattered yet."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The daily scenery shifts little by little each day.
Being able to appreciate the changing seasons comes only from having peace of mind.
choice_data_list: (Yeah... Maybe this was for the best.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WHOOOOSH! *Flap flap!*)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah... I hope I can catch up—hyaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle chased after the scarf carried off by the wind.
Though slow, she steadily picked up speed,
and finally caught the scarf.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Phew, good thing it didn't fall on the ground.
Your scarf is totally fine, Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh my, Flight-chan.
Did I accidentally step on something?!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine.
I was just looking for fallen nuts.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, acorns, soapberries, and such.
I'm making a ribbon barrette for my autumn outfit,
so I thought I'd use them as an accent.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Huh, it has such an autumn feel to it! Maybe I should add some acorn accessories to this outfit too."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Shall I make one for you too, Mirako-san? I brought extra ribbon barrettes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, really!?
...Wait, sorry, I didn't mean to beg!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. It's sure to look great with those clothes♪
Now, could you help me look for some nuts to use?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Found a cute one! ...Ah, it's got a scratch.
Mmmgh, it's really hard to find a pristine one."
choice_data_list: That's it, if we go deep where it's hard to get stepped on...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you found so many!
Well then, I'll deliver them once they're ready.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you were searching even more frantically than me, weren't you?
Look, you're covered in mud...
choice_data_list: Haha... I just wanted to find the prettiest one.
Ahaha... I just wanted to find the prettiest one.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Finished washing your hands?
Ah... they're bright red. It's that chilly time of year for cold water, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Give me your hand.
My sleeves are fluffy and warm, so...
here you go.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Phew, good thing it didn't fall into the field.
Trainer... Ah, watch your step!
choice_data_list: Whoa! What is that, a flowerpot!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, I'm so sorry!
I was just in the middle of cooking with the tandoor oven~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The culprit behind the trip was a large flowerpot.
Beside it sat a metal pail of similar size.
Could this be a homemade tandoor oven...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You place a flowerpot inside a pail,
pack insulation all around it... and add charcoal—
choice_data_list: You're right, it's the oven they bake naan in!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean we're gonna bake that spiced chicken,
saury, sweet potatoes, mushrooms, and all
the other tastes of autumn—in this kiln?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup!
Do you want some too, Miracle-san?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'll eat♪
Of course, I'll help grill it too~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe...
There's just no resisting the autumn appetite~.

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeek!
A-All those dead leaves I gathered up
are a mess again...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle managed to catch the scarf,
but in the process, she seemingly trampled all over
the raked-up dead leaves...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry...
Um, let me... help with cleaning too...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... No matter how much I sweep, it never ends~.
Dammit, autumn! There are way too many fallen leaves~!
